children.name: Butomus junceus Turcz.
children.description: Butomus is the only known genus in the  plant family Butomaceae, native to Europe and Asia. It is considered invasive in some parts of the United States.

children.name: Butomus umbellatus L.
children.description: Butomus umbellatus is a Eurasian plant species in the family Butomaceae.
